title: MRCD: contextual recognition engine for disfluency detection in Spanish speech
description: MRCD (Motor de Reconocimiento Contextual de Disfluencias) is a local HTTP service that detects filler words, prolongations and repetitions in Spanish speech through the versioned JSON contract mrcd.analysis/v1. This archive contains the source code only (MIT license); the trained checkpoint is distributed separately under its own terms.
